info.title: Boss Insights
info.description:
A single API that provides a holistic view of business data including accounting, banking, commerce, marketing and more. This documentation is intended for software developers and covers the Boss Insights API endpoints.
📚 Looking for an API overview? You'll find that at our Developer Documentation site.

get.summary: Retrieves a Collection of accounting transaction resources
get.description: Retrieves a Collection of accounting transaction resources

parameters.description: The number of items per page
parameters.name: itemsPerPage

x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/accounting_transactions?start=SOME_STRING_VALUE&end=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE' \
  --header 'Authorization: Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, [
  CURLOPT_URL => "https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/accounting_transactions?start=SOME_STRING_VALUE&end=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE",
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => "",
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => "GET",
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
    "Authorization: Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH"
  ],
]);

$response = curl_exec($curl);
$err = curl_error($curl);

curl_close($curl);

if ($err) {
  echo "cURL Error #:" . $err;
} else {
  echo $response;
}

require 'uri'
require 'net/http'
require 'openssl'

url = URI("https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/accounting_transactions?start=SOME_STRING_VALUE&end=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

http = Net::HTTP.new(url.host, url.port)
http.use_ssl = true
http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE

request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(url)
request["Authorization"] = 'Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'

response = http.request(request)
puts response.read_body

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("example.myintranetapps.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH" }

conn.request("GET", "/api/accounting_transactions?start=SOME_STRING_VALUE&end=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"io/ioutil"
)

func main() {

	url := "https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/accounting_transactions?start=SOME_STRING_VALUE&end=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE"

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

  --url 'https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/activities?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE' \
  --header 'Authorization: Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, [
  CURLOPT_URL => "https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/activities?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE",
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => "",
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => "GET",
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
    "Authorization: Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH"
  ],
]);

$response = curl_exec($curl);
$err = curl_error($curl);

curl_close($curl);

if ($err) {
  echo "cURL Error #:" . $err;
} else {
  echo $response;
}

require 'uri'
require 'net/http'
require 'openssl'

url = URI("https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/activities?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

http = Net::HTTP.new(url.host, url.port)
http.use_ssl = true
http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE

request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(url)
request["Authorization"] = 'Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH'

response = http.request(request)
puts response.read_body

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("example.myintranetapps.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH" }

conn.request("GET", "/api/activities?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"io/ioutil"
)

func main() {

	url := "https://example.myintranetapps.com/api/activities?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&itemsPerPage=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE"

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Basic REPLACE_BASIC_AUTH")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}

ProductCreateResourceRequest.description: Any offered product or service. For example: a pair of shoes; a concert ticket; the rental of a car; a haircut; or an episode of a TV show streamed online.

integration.description:
The key of the integration source
e.g. "quickbooks", or "xero"

additionalType.description: An additional type for the item, typically used for adding more specific types from external vocabularies in microdata syntax. This is a relationship between something and a class that the thing is in. In RDFa syntax, it is better to use the native RDFa syntax - the 'typeof' attribute - for multiple types. Schema.org tools may have only weaker understanding of extra types, in particular those defined externally.

award.description: an award won by or for this item

categories.description: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

disambiguatingDescription.description: A sub property of description. A short description of the item used to disambiguate from other, similar items. Information from other properties (in particular, name) may be necessary for the description to be useful for disambiguation.

gtin12.description: The \[GTIN-12\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-12.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. The GTIN-12 is the 12-digit GS1 Identification Key composed of a U.P.C. Company Prefix, Item Reference, and Check Digit used to identify trade items. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin13s.description: The \[GTIN-13\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-13.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This is equivalent to 13-digit ISBN codes and EAN UCC-13. Former 12-digit UPC codes can be converted into a GTIN-13 code by simply adding a preceeding zero. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin14s.description: The \[GTIN-14\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-14.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin8s.description: The \[GTIN-8\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-8.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This code is also known as EAN/UCC-8 or 8-digit EAN. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin12.description: The \[GTIN-12\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-12.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. The GTIN-12 is the 12-digit GS1 Identification Key composed of a U.P.C. Company Prefix, Item Reference, and Check Digit used to identify trade items. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin13s.description: The \[GTIN-13\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-13.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This is equivalent to 13-digit ISBN codes and EAN UCC-13. Former 12-digit UPC codes can be converted into a GTIN-13 code by simply adding a preceeding zero. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin14s.description: The \[GTIN-14\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-14.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin8s.description: The \[GTIN-8\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-8.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This code is also known as EAN/UCC-8 or 8-digit EAN. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

image.description: An image of the item. This can be a \[\[URL\]\] or a fully described \[\[ImageObject\]\].

isAccessoryOrSparePartFors.description: a pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is an accessory or spare part

isConsumableFors.description: a pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is a consumable

isRelatedTo.description: a pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products)

isSimilarTos.description: a pointer to another, functionally similar product (or multiple products)

itemCondition.description: a predefined value from OfferItemCondition or a textual description of the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer

model.description: The model of the product. Use with the URL of a ProductModel or a textual representation of the model identifier. The URL of the ProductModel can be from an external source. It is recommended to additionally provide strong product identifiers via the gtin8/gtin13/gtin14 and mpn properties.

mpns.description: the Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, or the product to which the offer refers

productID.description: The product identifier, such as ISBN. For example: ``` meta itemprop="productID" content="isbn:123-456-789" ```.

releaseDate.description: The release date of a product or product model. This can be used to distinguish the exact variant of a product.

sameA.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

skus.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU), i.e. a merchant-specific identifier for a product or service, or the product to which the offer refers.

productionDate.description: The date of production of the item, e.g. vehicle.

purchaseDate.description: The date the item e.g. vehicle was purchased by the current owner.

e.g. "quickbooks", or "xero"

Interval unit defining how often the invoice is charged
e.g. WEEKLY
e.g. MONTHLY

dueDate.description: Number of days defining when the invoice is scheduled to be charged

dueDateType.description:
The type of billing used together with due date
e.g. "DAYSAFTERBILLDATE"
e.g. "DAYSAFTERBILLMONTH"
e.g. "OFCURRENTMONTH"
e.g. "OFFOLLOWINGMONTH"

startDate.description: date on which the recurring invoice starts

nextScheduledDate.description: date at which next invoice is to be sent

type.description:
The type of invoice
e.g. "ACCPAY"
e.g. "ACCREC"

hasAttachments.description: Whether the invoice has attachments or not

contactId.description: Id of customer for whom recurring invoice is raised

contactName.description: Full name of contact

status.description:
Status of the repeating invoice
e.g. "DRAFT"
e.g. "AUTHORISED"

lineAmountTypes.description: Whether the line amount includes, excludes or doesn't have tax.

lineItemDescription.description: A description of the line item

lineItemUnitAmount.description: The unit amount of the line item

items.description: Payout represents received funds made out to a bank account or debit card

id.description:
Unique identifier for payout
note that no particular pattern in this field is guaranteed, only that this field is unique
e.g. "quickbooks-726"

integration.description:
The key of the integration source
e.g. "quickbooks", or "xero"

srcId.description:
The unique identifier of the source 3rd party integration
e.g.  "GH2JK-67283H-YW82KHX-2883KK-KS78S"

amount.description:
The amount to be transferred to a bank account or debit card in cents
e.g. 74753

arrivalDate.description:
The date and time the payout is expected to arrive in the bank
e.g. "2020-11-03T02:17:40.080Z"

automatic.description:
Whether the payout was created by an automated payout schedule or not
e.g. "true"

balanceTransactionId.description:
The ID of the balance transaction that describes the impact of this payout on the account balance
e.g. "7464"

created.description:
The date and time this payout was created
e.g. "2020-11-03"

currency.description:
Currency the payout is made in
e.g. "USD"

payoutDescription.description:
A description of the payout
e.g. "Payout description"

destinationId.description:
The ID of the bank account or card the payout is sent to
e.g. "44"

failureBalanceTransactionId.description:
The ID of the balance transaction if the payout failed or cancelled
e.g. "py_1L9D8G2eZgTElo2CaKQjce77"

failureCode.description: Error code explaining reason for payout failure.

failureMessage.description:
Message to user further explaining reason for payout failure
e.g. "payment failed"

method.description:
Method used to send this payout
e.g. "Standard"
e.g. "Instant"
e.g. "Standard"

sourceType.description:
The source balance this payout came from
e.g. "card"
e.g. "bank_account"

status.description:
Current status of the payout
e.g. "paid"
e.g. "pending"

award.description: an award won by or for this item

disambiguatingDescription.description: A sub property of description. A short description of the item used to disambiguate from other, similar items. Information from other properties (in particular, name) may be necessary for the description to be useful for disambiguation.

gtin12.description: The \[GTIN-12\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-12.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. The GTIN-12 is the 12-digit GS1 Identification Key composed of a U.P.C. Company Prefix, Item Reference, and Check Digit used to identify trade items. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin13s.description: The \[GTIN-13\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-13.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This is equivalent to 13-digit ISBN codes and EAN UCC-13. Former 12-digit UPC codes can be converted into a GTIN-13 code by simply adding a preceeding zero. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin14s.description: The \[GTIN-14\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-14.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

gtin8s.description: The \[GTIN-8\](http://apps.gs1.org/GDD/glossary/Pages/GTIN-8.aspx) code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This code is also known as EAN/UCC-8 or 8-digit EAN. See \[GS1 GTIN Summary\](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

image.description: An image of the item. This can be a \[\[URL\]\] or a fully described \[\[ImageObject\]\].

isAccessoryOrSparePartFors.description: a pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is an accessory or spare part

isConsumableFors.description: a pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is a consumable

isRelatedTo.description: a pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products)

isSimilarTos.description: a pointer to another, functionally similar product (or multiple products)

itemCondition.description: a predefined value from OfferItemCondition or a textual description of the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer

model.description: The model of the product. Use with the URL of a ProductModel or a textual representation of the model identifier. The URL of the ProductModel can be from an external source. It is recommended to additionally provide strong product identifiers via the gtin8/gtin13/gtin14 and mpn properties.

mpns.description: the Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, or the product to which the offer refers

productID.description: The product identifier, such as ISBN. For example: ``` meta itemprop="productID" content="isbn:123-456-789" ```.

releaseDate.description: The release date of a product or product model. This can be used to distinguish the exact variant of a product.

sameA.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

skus.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU), i.e. a merchant-specific identifier for a product or service, or the product to which the offer refers.

material.description: A material that something is made from, e.g. leather, wool, cotton, paper.

productionDate.description: The date of production of the item, e.g. vehicle.

purchaseDate.description: The date the item e.g. vehicle was purchased by the current owner.

identifier.description: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of \[\[Thing\]\], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. type.description:
The type of invoice
e.g. "ACCPAY"
e.g. "ACCREC"

hasAttachments.description: Whether the invoice has attachments or not

status.description:
Status of the repeating invoice
e.g. "DRAFT"
e.g. "AUTHORISED"

lineAmountTypes.description: Whether the line amount includes, excludes or doesn't have tax.

The type of tax applied to line items
e.g. "OUTPUT"
e.g. "INPUT"
e.g. "CAPEXINPUT"

lineAmount.description: The final amount for the line items

lineItemAccountCode.description: Account code for the line item

lineItemQuantity.description: The quantity of the line items

lineItemId.description: Unique ID for the line item

recurrenceName.description: Unique name for the recurring profile given by the user

endDate.description: date on which the recurring invoice expires

lastSentDate.description: date at which the last invoice was sent

integration.description:
The key of the integration source
e.g. "quickbooks", or "xero"

srcId.description:
The unique identifier of the source 3rd party integration
e.g. "GH2JK-67283H-YW82KHX-2883KK-KS78S"

givenName.description:
First name of the vendor
e.g. "Jane"

familyName.description:
Last name of the vendor
e.g. "Doe"

companyName.description:
Name of the company
e.g. "Doyle-Koch LLC"

contactName.description:
Name of the main contact for the vendor
  e.g. "John Smith"

contactTitle.description:
Title of the main contact for the vendor
  e.g. "Account Manager"

accountNumber.description:
Account number for the vendor
  e.g. "420042"

email.description:
Email address for the vendor
e.g. "doyle-koch@email.com"

address.description:
First line of vendor address
e.g. "708 Woodland Avenue"

addressLine2.description:
Vendor address line 2
e.g. "Unit 105"

city.description:
City of the address
e.g. "St Paul"

country.description:
Country of the address
   * e.g. "United States"

postalCode.description:
Postal code of the address
   * e.g. "99660"

currency.description:
Currency code used by vendor
e.g. "USD"

balance.description:
Balance in ledger for vendor in cents
e.g. 650000

bankAccountName.description:
Bank account name associated with the vendor
e.g. "Business Bank Account"

bankAccountNumber.description:
Bank acount number associated with the vendor
e.g. "123654"

notes.description:
Additional note attached to vendor
e.g. "Quality vendor"

taxType.description:
Type of tax applied to vendor
e.g. "Global"

isContractor.description: Whether the vendor is a contractor

active.description: Whether the vendor is active

created.description:
Date of vendor account creation
e.g. "2013-11-18T02:17:40.080Z"

modified.description:
Date entry was last modified
e.g. "2013-11-22T02:17:40.080Z"

termId.description:
Reference to a Term object (payment terms) associated with this Vendor
e.g. "1d80716b-427e-4cad-80c6-c4b3a18eb23d"

termDays.description:
The days value of the payment terms for this Vendor
e.g. "15"

termType.description:
The type of the payment terms for this Vendor
e.g. "DAYSAFTERBILLDATE"
